row.notes: Presents reward entry index of the current unlock group (vm+0xAF0: vector +8..+0x10 of 0x108-byte rewards, group type +0x20); if index is past the end it calls Game_AwardCeremonyViewModel_HandleUnlockGroupCeremony for the next group. Reads reward type byte +0 and subtype byte +4, rarity +8, amount +0xC, strings +0x18/+0x20/+0x40, item id +0xE8 and pushes them to VM nodes at vm+0x370..+0xA30 (title, icons, has-prev/has-next bools at +0x4D0/+0x4F0, amount text via Ui_Format_ResourcePointsAmountText, currency totals). Strings: #overrides.f1_world.resource_icons[pitcoin], #overrides.f1_world.resource_icons[xp], lng_ceremony_objective_rewards_description .. lng_ceremony_other_rewards_description, lng_fanzones, SEASON slot. Good hook to inspect or alter rewards shown in F1 World ceremonies.
